title: Touring in a band with Bab Frank and Papa Celestin
summary: Picou agrees he was in a big brass band that travelled widely.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah. Somebody the other day, a Wellman Bro, the bass player, said once when he was young he heard a band, he thought it was the Georgia Minstrels, a big brass band that had Bab Frank in it. Oh yeah, Bab Frank, piccolo. Yes, and I think he said he heard you in that band. Yeah. And maybe one of the T.O.'s. Yeah, yeah, we all was there. You travelled around the country then? Oh, sorry, that's what countries, I think I know every country, that's no one.
